title: A Black Mamba Races With Its Head Four Feet Up

scenes.text: A black mamba races with its head four feet off the ground.
It moves at over twelve miles an hour in short bursts, among the fastest snakes on Earth.
It grows up to fourteen feet long.
Its venom attacks the nervous system and heart. Without antivenom, a bite is nearly always fatal, and death can come in twenty minutes.
Even so, black mambas cause only a small number of human deaths each year.
Head up. Twelve miles an hour. Fourteen feet long.

description:
A black mamba can race along with its head nearly four feet off the ground at over 12 mph.
It can reach 14 feet long and carries one of the most dangerous venoms of any snake.
Would you ever stay in the same field as one?
first_comment: Would you rather outrun a mamba or outswim a crocodile?
